title: RenderCapabilityProfile
description: Source of truth: auto-derived at doorway startup from on-disk bundles intersected with elohim-storage's manifest of SSR-eligible routes (Operational, Category C). doorway-config.toml may reduce the claim but never inflate it. Layered into PeerStatusView via build_peer_status_view, mirroring the elohimCapability pattern. NOT a DHT entry.

_source.owner: doorway runtime (derived from disk + storage manifest)
_source.rationale: Compute-shape claim about doorway-local SSR capability; informational visibility for substrate matchmaking. Stage-3 elohim-defender enforcement is the deferred path that would graduate the claim to DHT-attested.

digest.description: Optional sha256 hash of the bundle file

renderers.description: Distinct renderer kinds (deduplicated bundles[].renderer). Cheap-to-query summary.

authModes.description: Auth modes this doorway honors for SSR. 'anonymous' must always be present.

maxConcurrentRenders.description: Operator-declared concurrency budget. CSR fallback fires when reached.

memoryBudgetMib.description: Operator-declared memory ceiling for the renderer (informational; null = cgroup-managed)
